info.title: mirror-v3 cache
info.description: Drop-in HTTP surface for Yolean/kafka-keyvalue's /cache/v1. Each opt-in mirror (`http-access.cache-v1`) owns its own in-memory `key → latest-value` view, exposed under `/cache/v1/{mirror}/...`. A single mirror may additionally opt into `cache-v1-main`, which mounts the unprefixed `/cache/v1/...` paths onto its view as a migration alias for legacy kkv consumers; these unprefixed routes are config-conditional and intentionally omitted from this spec. Updates are per-record from the consume loop; reads return 503 until the target mirror has caught up to its startup high-watermark.

202.description: Shutdown accepted; the supervisor will exit shortly with code 0

post.summary: POST /_admin/v1/shutdown/{exitcode}; request graceful exit with a specific code.

parameters.name: exitcode
parameters.description: Exit code the supervisor will return

202.description: Shutdown accepted; the supervisor will exit with the requested code

get.summary:
GET /cache/v1/{mirror}/keys; newline-separated key list for the
named mirror's view. Every line (including the last) is
terminated by `\n`. Order is insertion order (the position a key
gets the *first* time the mirror sees it).
get.description:
`Content-Type` is `application/octet-stream` to match KKV's
byte-for-byte response shape.

parameters.name: mirror
parameters.description: Name of the `http-access.cache-v1` mirror to read from

503.description: Mirror is not yet caught up to its source

get.summary:
GET /cache/v1/{mirror}/offset/{topic}/{partition}; last-seen
offset for that (topic, partition) within the named mirror.

parameters.name: mirror
parameters.description: Name of the `http-access.cache-v1` mirror to read from

200.description: Decimal offset of the last applied record on this mirror, or empty if none yet

get.summary:
GET /cache/v1/{mirror}/raw/{key}; fetch a value by key from the
named mirror's view. The unprefixed `/cache/v1/raw/{key}` alias
is mounted by `build_router` when one mirror opted into
`http-access.cache-v1-main`, and dispatches here with that
mirror's name.

parameters.name: mirror
parameters.description: Name of the `http-access.cache-v1` mirror to read from

200.description: Value bytes for the requested key

404.description: Mirror unknown, or key not in cache

503.description: Mirror is not yet caught up to its source

get.summary:
GET /cache/v1/{mirror}/values; newline-separated values for the
named mirror's view, in `keys` order. Binary-safe **only** when
none of the values contain a `0x0A` byte; binary topics should
pin `values: { type: bytes-base64 }` so the cache returns the
base64-encoded form here.

parameters.name: mirror
parameters.description: Name of the `http-access.cache-v1` mirror to read from

200.description: Newline-separated raw values with trailing newline; binary-safe iff no value contains 0x0A

503.description: Mirror is not yet caught up to its source

TopicPartitionOffsetJson.description:
`{topic, partition, offset}` shape serialized into the
`x-kkv-last-seen-offsets` header. Mirrors KKV's
`TopicPartitionOffset`, including JSON property order.
